name: Café Rio Seasoned Cilantro Lime Rice Side Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Steamed long-grain white rice infused with mild vegetable broth, light oil, and finely chopped cilantro. It is low in residue and very soothing to hyperactive bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for a side bowl of cilantro lime rice without cheese topping.
